carry_forward_constraints.constraint: Synthetic handles MUST use the literal prefix 'synthetic-handle-' (e.g. synthetic-handle-007). The seed + IdentityMapping + loadSeedProfiles must satisfy the /^synthetic-handle-/ assertions already in tests/foundation/no-pii.test.ts.

non_negotiables: BR-10 / AC-13: synthetic data only, ZERO real names/emails/PII anywhere (repo, DB, fixtures); secrets only via env, placeholders in .env.example.

BR-09: ALL intelligence routes through the Claude wrapper with Zod validate-before-write; safeParse failure or low confidence returns a typed Failure, never persists raw model text. No hardcoded/keyword/regex substitutes; awkward calls stubbed with a TODO that returns failure.
ADR-002: EXTEND the starter prisma/schema.prisma additively, do not replace; preserve starter @@unique keys.
Next.js 16 / Prisma v7 conventions: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before any Next.js code.
